rules.statement: The provision of section 5(a) is to be construed in conjunction with section 48.
rules.supporting_quote: In view of the provision of section 5 (a) read with section 48 (1), the claim of a monthly tenant is not within the scope of a partition action. It is not permissible to enter a finding, in a judgment, interlocutory decree of final decree, in a partition action with regard to any claim of a monthly tenant in respect of the land sought to be partitioned. Such question should be considered, if at all, at the stage of execution in terms of section 52 of the Law. 265 Per S. N. Silva, CJ. "In this instance the claims of the 4th defendant on the Indenture of Lease and compensation for improvements, have been validly brought within the partition action. But, the 4th defendant should not have been permitted to add another string to his bow by raising issues based on a monthly tenancy, being a matter in respect of which the Court could not enter a decree having finality."

rules.statement: A court cannot adjudicate on claims of monthly tenants as part of a partition action.
